translationPolicy.uzbekStyle: Professional, age-appropriate Uzbek; technical acronyms/keywords such as RAM, OS, MFA, SQL, IF/ELSE, AND/OR/NOT are retained where useful.
translationPolicy.principle: Translation preserves the tested construct and answer key rather than translating word-for-word.

en.context: A software developer wants to install an open-source package. A visually attractive website offers a downloadable package, but its public repository has zero stars, no release history, and no verified maintainer signature.
en.question: What is the most secure and effective way to verify the package before installing it?

options.A: Install the package immediately because the landing page has professional design.
options.B: Verify its version history on official registries (npm/PyPI), source code repository, license, and community audits.
options.C: Deploy the package directly to a production server to see if it works.
options.D: Assume it is safe because it appeared as a top sponsored search result.

en.explanation: When installing open-source libraries, visual aesthetics cannot guarantee safety. Developers must audit package registry metrics, maintainer signatures, and source repositories.

uz.context: Dasturchi yangi loyihaga ochiq kodli kutubxona qo‘shmoqchi. Qidiruvda dizayni chiroyli ko‘ringan, ammo GitHub yulduzchalari va yuklab olishlar soni nolga teng bo‘lgan shubhali paket chiqdi.
uz.question: Ushbu paketni loyihaga o‘rnatishdan oldin uning ishonchliligini tekshirishning eng xavfsiz va to‘g‘ri usuli qaysi?

options.A: Sayt dizayni zamonaviy bo‘lgani uchun paketni darhol o‘rnatish.
options.B: Paketning rasmiy reestr (npm/PyPI)dagi versiyalar tarixi, ochiq manba kodi, litsenziyasi va hamjamiyat sharhlarini tekshirish.
options.C: Paketni to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri production serverga yuklab sinab ko‘rish.
options.D: Qidiruv tizimida birinchi bo‘lib chiqqani uchun uni xavfsiz deb qabul qilish.

uz.explanation: Ochiq kodli dasturiy paketlarni o‘rnatishda sayt dizayniga emas, rasmiy reestrlar (npm, PyPI), manba kodi ochiqligi, yuklab olishlar soni va xavfsizlik auditiga tayanish zarur.

items.possibleFailurePattern: Deletion myth / local deletion = global deletion

en.context: A developer accidentally committed an API secret key to a public Git repository, then quickly removed the commit locally and force-pushed an update.
en.question: Why must the secret key still be considered compromised and immediately revoked?

options.A: When a Git commit is replaced, all cached copies on external servers are automatically erased.
options.B: Automated scraping bots, mirrors, forks, or local clones may have already captured the exposed secret from commit history.
options.C: API keys only become visible to third-party observers after 30 days.
options.D: Only the original repository owner has network permission to read commit diffs.

en.explanation: Public git repos are monitored by automated secret scanners. Deleting a commit does not eliminate exposure; credentials must be revoked immediately.

uz.context: Dasturchi ommaviy (public) Git repozitoriysiga adashib API maxfiy kalitini (API secret key) commit qilib yubordi. Keyin u darhol lokal kompyuterida so‘nggi commitni o‘chirib, repozitoriyni yangiladi.
uz.question: Nega maxfiy kalit ochiqlanib qolgan (komprometatsiya bo‘lgan) hisoblanadi va darhol bekor qilinishi (revoke) kerak?

options.A: Git commit o‘chirilgach, uning nusxasi butun dunyo bo‘yicha avtomatik o‘chib ketadi.
options.B: O‘chirilgunga qadar botlar, klonlar yoki keshlovchi servislar commit tarixidan kalitni nusxalab olgan bo‘lishi mumkin.
options.C: API kalitlari faqat 30 kundan keyin boshqalar uchun ko‘rinadigan bo‘ladi.
options.D: Faqat repozitoriy egasigina commit tarixini ko‘rish huquqiga ega.

uz.explanation: Public Git repozitoriylariga tushgan har qanday maxfiy ma’lumot avtomatlashtirilgan botlar tomonidan soniyalar ichida skanerlanadi. Tarixni o‘chirish xavfni bartaraf etmaydi, kalitni darhol bekor qilish kerak.

en.context: A developer needs official reference documentation for Python asynchronous sockets, but generic search queries return outdated forum discussions.
en.question: Which search operator query is the most direct and precise to locate the official documentation?

options.A: All good articles about Python socket programming
options.B: site:docs.python.org "asyncio" socket
options.C: async socket forum help questions
options.D: Reinstalling the browser and retyping the general keyword

en.explanation: Using domain filters (site:) and exact match quotes restricts results directly to official documentation roots.

uz.context: Dasturchi Python tilida asinxron soketlar (asyncio sockets) bo‘yicha rasmiy hujjatlarni (documentation) topmoqchi, biroq oddiy qidiruvda forumlardagi eskirgan postlar chiqmoqda.
uz.question: Qaysi qidiruv so‘rovi rasmiy hujjatlarni eng tez va aniq topib beradi?

options.A: Python socket dasturlash bo‘yicha barcha yaxshi maqolalar
options.B: site:docs.python.org "asyncio" socket
options.C: async socket forum yordam xatolari
options.D: Brauzerni qayta o‘rnatib, umumiy so‘rovni yana yozish

uz.explanation: site: operatori va qo‘shtirnoq ichidagi kalit so‘zlar qidiruvni aniq domen va aniq atama bilan cheklab, rasmiy hujjatlarni topishni tezlashtiradi.

items.subCompetency: File naming conventions in collaborative environments

en.context: A software development team needs a standard, unambiguous convention to version and track production releases.
en.question: Which release versioning convention follows the widely accepted Semantic Versioning (SemVer) standard?

options.A: app_new, app_new2, app_final_latest
options.B: app_v1, app_v2_fixed, app_v3_real

en.explanation: Semantic Versioning (SemVer: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) is the industry standard for communicating breaking changes, features, and patches.

uz.context: Jamoaviy dasturiy ta’minot ishlab chiqishda relizlar va kutubxonalar versiyalarini boshqarish talab etiladi.
uz.question: Dasturiy ta’minotda qaysi versiyalash standarti (Semantic Versioning) eng samarali va xalqaro qabul qilingan?

options.A: app_new, app_new2, app_final_oxirgi
options.B: app_v1, app_v2_tuzatilgan, app_v3_haqiqiy

uz.explanation: Semantic Versioning (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) xalqaro standart bo‘lib, dasturning mosligi, yangi funksiyalari va tuzatishlarini aniq bildiradi.

en.context: A developer building a commercial paid software product finds a utility library published under a Creative Commons BY-NC (Non-Commercial) license.
en.question: According to this license, how can the developer legally use this code?

options.A: Because the code is public, it can be bundled and sold inside a commercial product.
options.B: It may be used with attribution only for non-commercial purposes; commercial monetization is prohibited.
options.C: Removing the license header allows unrestricted proprietary monetization.
options.D: CC BY-NC strictly forbids executing the software on any computer.

en.explanation: BY-NC licenses grant free use with attribution strictly for non-commercial purposes, barring commercial integration.

uz.context: Dasturchi tijoriy (pullik) dastur tuzmoqda va GitHub dan CC BY-NC (Non-Commercial) litsenziyasidagi kod modulini topdi.
uz.question: Ushbu litsenziya qoidasiga ko‘ra moduldan qanday foydalanish mumkin?

options.A: Kod ochiq bo‘lgani uchun uni pullik dastur ichiga qo‘shib sotish mumkin.
options.B: Muallifni ko‘rsatgan holda faqat notijoriy/ta’lim maqsadlarida foydalanish mumkin; uni tijoriy mahsulotda sotish taqiqlanadi.
options.C: Litsenziyani o‘chirib tashlab, kodni o‘z muallifligi ostida xohlagancha ishlatish mumkin.
options.D: CC BY-NC litsenziyasi kodni hech qachon ishga tushirishga ruxsat bermaydi.

uz.explanation: CC BY-NC mualliflikni ko‘rsatishni (BY) va faqat notijoriy (NC) foydalanishni talab qiladi; tijoriy loyihalarda foydalanish qonunan taqiqlanadi.

en.context: An authentication API service receives a username and password from a client, hashes the password with bcrypt and compares it to the database record, then returns a signed JWT access token.
en.question: Which part represents the Process stage of the system?

options.A: The user typing their username and password into the client form.
options.B: Hashing the password with bcrypt, comparing it against the stored hash, and evaluating authentication.
options.C: Transmitting the generated JWT access token back to the HTTP client.
options.D: Physical ethernet cables transmitting raw packet voltages.

en.explanation: Credentials are Input, the JWT token is Output, and the cryptographic hash calculation and verification is Process.

uz.context: Foydalanuvchini autentifikatsiyadan o‘tkazuvchi API servisi mijozdan login va parolni qabul qiladi, parolni bcrypt algoritmi orqali xeshlab ma’lumotlar bazasidagi yozuv bilan solishtiradi va mijozga JWT tokenini qaytaradi.
uz.question: Tizimning "Process" (qayta ishlash / hisoblash) bosqichi qaysi?

options.A: Foydalanuvchining klaviaturada login va parolni kiritishi.
options.B: Parolni bcrypt orqali xeshlab, bazadagi xesh bilan solishtirish va autentifikatsiya qarorini qabul qilish.
options.C: Mijoz ilovasiga JWT tokenini JSON ko‘rinishida qaytarish.
options.D: Tarmoq kabeli orqali elektr signallarining uzatilishi.

uz.explanation: Kirish (Input) — login va parol, Chiqish (Output) — JWT token. Hisoblash va solishtirish jarayoni esa Qayta ishlash (Process) bosqichidir.

en.context: A pointer in a 2D grid starts at coordinate (1,1). MOVE_RIGHT increments x (x = x + 1), while MOVE_UP increments y (y = y + 1).
en.question: Which instruction sequence moves the pointer to (2,3)?

options.A: MOVE_RIGHT, MOVE_UP
options.B: MOVE_RIGHT, MOVE_UP, MOVE_UP
options.C: MOVE_RIGHT, MOVE_RIGHT, MOVE_UP

en.explanation: Starting at (1,1), one MOVE_RIGHT gives (2,1) and two MOVE_UP commands increment y by 2 to reach (2,3).

uz.context: 2D matritsada kursor (1,1) koordinatadan boshlaydi. MOVE_RIGHT x koordinatasini 1 ga oshiradi (x = x + 1), MOVE_UP esa y koordinatasini 1 ga oshiradi (y = y + 1).
uz.question: Kursorni (2,3) koordinataga olib borish uchun qaysi buyruqlar ketma-ketligi to‘g‘ri?

options.A: MOVE_RIGHT, MOVE_UP
options.B: MOVE_RIGHT, MOVE_UP, MOVE_UP
options.C: MOVE_RIGHT, MOVE_RIGHT, MOVE_UP

uz.explanation: (1,1) dan bitta MOVE_RIGHT (2,1) ga olib keladi. Ikkita MOVE_UP esa y ni 1 dan 3 ga oshiradi: (2,3).

en.context: A data mapping pipeline transforms tokens according to a cyclic rule: Circle → Square, Square → Triangle, Triangle → Circle.
en.question: If the input array is [Circle, Triangle], what is the transformed output?

options.A: [Square, Circle]
options.B: [Triangle, Square]
options.C: [Circle, Triangle]

en.explanation: Circle maps to Square, and Triangle maps to Circle. Output is [Square, Circle].

uz.context: Ma’lumotlarni qayta ishlash algoritmi har bir belgini tsiklik qoida bo‘yicha almashtiradi: Circle → Square, Square → Triangle, Triangle → Circle.
uz.question: Kiruvchi massiv [Circle, Triangle] bo‘lsa, algoritm chiqargan natija qanday bo‘ladi?

options.A: [Square, Circle]
options.B: [Triangle, Square]
options.C: [Circle, Triangle]

uz.explanation: Circle qoida bo‘yicha Square ga, Triangle esa Circle ga aylanadi. Natija: [Square, Circle].

en.context: An engineering team is architecting a full-scale e-commerce platform from scratch.
en.question: Which option demonstrates the most effective architectural decomposition of this system?

options.A: Writing all business logic into a single file and naming servers alphabetically.
options.B: Focusing solely on UI wireframes while postponing database design.
options.C: Decomposing into Authentication, Product Catalog, Cart/Payment Gateway, and Order Database services.
options.D: Hiring more developers and prioritizing advertising campaigns.

en.explanation: Decomposition isolates distinct domain responsibilities into modular, maintainable subsystems.

uz.context: Muhandislar jamoasi yirik elektron tijorat (E-commerce) veb-platformasi arxitekturasini noldan loyihalashtirmoqda.
uz.question: Ushbu tizimni to‘g‘ri mustaqil modullarga (arxitekturaviy dekompozitsiya) ajratish qaysi variantda ko‘rsatilgan?

options.A: Barcha kodni bitta katta faylga yozib, server nomini alifbo tartibida tanlash.
options.B: Faqat frontend dizayniga e’tibor qaratib, ma’lumotlar bazasini keyinroq o‘ylash.
options.C: Tizimni Autentifikatsiya, Mahsulotlar katalogi, Savatcha/To‘lov servisi va Buyurtmalar bazasiga ajratish.
options.D: Dasturchilar sonini oshirish va faqat marketing reklamasini rejalashtirish.

uz.explanation: Murakkab tizimni funksional jihatdan mustaqil xizmatlarga bo‘lish — bu to‘g‘ri arxitekturaviy dekompozitsiyadir.

en.context: A software engineer is designing a high-level Database Client API for backend developers.
en.question: To maintain effective abstraction, which low-level detail should be hidden from API consumers?

options.A: The high-level query() execution method.
options.B: The connection establishment connect() method.
options.C: Network interface bus voltages and low-level hardware interrupt register offsets.
options.D: The schema format of returned dataset rows.

en.explanation: Abstraction hides physical hardware complexities behind high-level declarative interfaces.

uz.context: Ma’lumotlar bazasi drayverini yozayotgan dasturchi ilova dasturchilari uchun ma’lumotlar bazasiga ulanish interfeysini (API) loyihalashtirmoqda.
uz.question: Interfeysni tushunarli va abstrakt saqlash uchun qaysi past darajali (low-level) apparat detali dasturchidan yashirilishi (abstraksiya qilinishi) kerak?

options.A: SQL so‘rovlarini bajaruvchi query() metodi.
options.B: Ma’lumotlar bazasiga ulanish uchun connect() funksiyasi.
options.C: Tarmoq platasidagi elektr kuchlanishi va xotira kontrollerining apparat uzilishlari (interrupts).
options.D: Qaytariladigan ma’lumotlar jadvali va qatorlar formati.

uz.explanation: Abstraksiya past darajadagi apparat tafsilotlarini yashirib, qulay dasturiy interfeys (API) taqdim etadi.

en.context:
Trace this Python code line by line:
X = 10
Y = 5
X = Y
Y = X
en.question: What are the values of X and Y after the last line?
en.explanation: X = Y sets X to 5, overwriting 10. Then Y = X assigns 5 to Y. Both variables hold 5.

uz.context:
Python kodini tahlil qiling:
X = 10
Y = 5
X = Y
Y = X
uz.question: Oxirgi qatordan keyin X va Y ning qiymatlari nechaga teng?
uz.explanation: X = Y qatorida X ga 5 yoziladi. Keyingi Y = X qatorida esa Y ga yangi X (ya’ni 5) yoziladi. Ikkalasi ham 5 bo‘lib qoladi.

en.context:
Trace this Python loop:
total = 0
for number in [1, 2, 3]:
    total = total + number
en.question: What is the value of total after the loop finishes?
en.explanation: The accumulator adds each element sequentially: 0 + 1 + 2 + 3 = 6.

uz.context:
Python siklini tahlil qiling:
total = 0
for number in [1, 2, 3]:
    total = total + number
uz.question: Sikl tugagach, total o‘zgaruvchisining yakuniy qiymati nima bo‘ladi?
uz.explanation: Akkumulyator: 0 + 1 = 1; 1 + 2 = 3; 3 + 3 = 6. Yakuniy qiymat: 6.

en.context:
Trace this pseudocode:
Score ← 75
IF Score > 80 THEN
    Grade ← "A"
ELSE
    Grade ← "B"
ENDIF
en.question: What is the final value of Grade?

options.B: A
options.C: B

en.explanation: 75 is not greater than 80, so the ELSE branch executes, setting Grade to 'B'.

uz.context:
Kodni tahlil qiling:
Score ← 75
IF Score > 80 THEN
    Grade ← "A"
ELSE
    Grade ← "B"
ENDIF
uz.question: Grade ning yakuniy qiymati nima bo‘ladi?

options.B: A
options.C: B

uz.explanation: Score (75) > 80 sharti False bo‘lgani sababli ELSE bloki bajariladi va Grade = "B" bo‘ladi.

en.context:
An API service checks access permissions using this compound Boolean expression:
(all_tasks_completed == True) and (penalty < 5 or is_senior == True)
en.question: Which evaluation state results in True (access granted)?

options.A: all_tasks_completed = True; penalty = 10; is_senior = False
options.B: all_tasks_completed = False; penalty = 0; is_senior = True
options.C: all_tasks_completed = True; penalty = 2; is_senior = False

en.explanation: Option C satisfies both sides of the AND: all_tasks_completed is True, and (2 < 5) evaluates to True.

uz.context:
API serverida foydalanuvchiga resursga kirish ruxsati quyidagi mantiqiy shart asosida beriladi:
(all_tasks_completed == True) and (penalty < 5 or is_senior == True)
uz.question: Quyidagi holatlardan qaysi birida mantiqiy ifoda to‘liq True (ruxsat berilgan) bo‘ladi?

options.A: all_tasks_completed = True; penalty = 10; is_senior = False
options.B: all_tasks_completed = False; penalty = 0; is_senior = True
options.C: all_tasks_completed = True; penalty = 2; is_senior = False

uz.explanation: all_tasks_completed = True va (2 < 5 True yoki False) = True. Ikkala qism ham True bo‘lib, natija True bo‘ladi.

en.context: A validator function accepts integer age values in the inclusive range 13 <= age <= 19.
en.question: Which set represents the optimal boundary value analysis test data?
en.explanation: Boundary value testing verifies the exact boundaries (13, 19) and the immediate out-of-bounds neighbors (12, 20).

uz.context: Funksiya 13 dan 19 gacha (ikkala chegara ham kiradi: 13 <= age <= 19) bo‘lgan yosh oralig‘idagi ma’lumotlarni qabul qiladi.
uz.question: Ushbu funksiya chegaralarini to‘liq tekshirish (boundary value analysis) uchun qaysi test qiymatlari to‘plami eng to‘g‘ri?
uz.explanation: Chegaraviy testlashda chegaralarning o‘zi (13, 19) va ulardan bir birlik tashqaridagi qiymatlar (12, 20) tekshiriladi.

en.context: A database buffer cache is processing transactions in memory before committing to disk. An abrupt power failure occurs and uncommitted buffer data is lost.
en.question: Which volatile hardware component was holding the unsaved buffer data prior to power loss?

options.A: RAM (Random Access Memory)
options.B: Hard Drive / SSD
options.C: ROM (Read-Only Memory)

en.explanation: RAM is volatile memory; its state is lost immediately when electrical power is interrupted.

uz.context: Serverda dastur ma’lumotlarni qayta ishlamoqda, lekin hali doimiy xotiraga (disk/SSD) saqlamagan edi. To‘satdan server quvvati o‘chib qoldi va xotiradagi barcha saqlanmagan ma’lumotlar yo‘qoldi.
uz.question: Elektr o‘chishidan oldin saqlanmagan ma’lumotlar qaysi uchuvchan (volatile) apparat komponentida turgan edi?

options.A: RAM (Tezkor xotira)
options.B: Qattiq disk / SSD
options.C: ROM (Doimiy xotira)

uz.explanation: RAM (operativ xotira) — uchuvchan (volatile) xotira bo‘lib, elektr toki uzilganda ma’lumotlarini yo‘qotadi.

en.context: A large video stream is segmented into network packets before transmission over TCP/IP.
en.question: Which statement accurately describes packet routing across packet-switched networks?

options.A: All packets are strictly constrained to traverse the exact same physical path.
options.B: Packets can travel via different dynamic routes and arrive at the destination out of order.
options.C: A single dropped packet causes total network architecture failure.
options.D: Packets must be reassembled into a single block before entering routers.

en.explanation: Packet switching routes datagrams independently across dynamic paths; TCP reorders them at the destination.

uz.context: Katta video fayl internet tarmog‘i orqali uzatilishidan oldin paketlarga (Packet Switching) bo‘linadi.
uz.question: Paketli kommutatsiya (packet switching) tarmoqlarida paketlar harakati haqida qaysi fikr to‘g‘ri?

options.A: Barcha paketlar bir xil jismoniy simdan ketma-ket borishi shart.
options.B: Paketlar turli yo‘llardan borishi va yuborilgan tartibdan boshqa tartibda yetib kelishi mumkin.
options.C: Bitta paket yo‘qolsa, butun tarmoq doimiy ishdan chiqadi.
options.D: Paketlar internetga kirishdan oldin yana bitta katta blokka birlashtiriladi.

uz.explanation: IP paketlar turli marshrutlar orqali mustaqil harakatlanadi va qabul qiluvchi tomonda TCP sarlavhasidagi tartib raqamlari bo‘yicha qayta teriladi.

en.context: You receive an urgent email from security-support@yourbank-update.net stating: "Your account will be deleted in 2 hours unless you log in through this link".
en.question: What is the safest technical first step to handle this phishing attempt?

options.A: Click the link immediately to verify.
options.B: Reply to the email demanding verification.
options.C: Never click the email link; navigate directly to the verified official banking domain.
options.D: Download the attached security software executable.

en.explanation: Avoid clicking untrusted email links; navigate independently to the verified domain URL.

uz.context: Siz security-support@yourbank-update.net manzilidan "2 soat ichida havolaga kirib hisobga kirmasangiz, akkauntingiz o‘chiriladi" degan shoshilinch xat olasiz.
uz.question: Ushbu fishing (phishing) xurujiga qarshi eng xavfsiz birinchi qadam qaysi?

options.A: Havolani darhol bosib tekshirish.
options.B: Xatga javob berib, haqiqiyligini isbotlashni so‘rash.
options.C: Havolani bosmasdan, bankning rasmiy sayt manzilini o‘zingiz kiritib ochish.
options.D: “Xavfsizlik siyosati”ni o‘qish uchun ilovani yuklab olish.

uz.explanation: Shubhali xatlardagi havolalarni bosmaslik va rasmiy domenni brauzerga mustaqil kiritish fishingdan himoyalanishning asosiy qoidasidir.

en.context: Modern computers run an operating system alongside user-space applications.
en.question: What is the primary role of the Operating System (OS)?

options.A: Drafting documents and rendering spreadsheets.
options.B: Managing hardware resources and providing a secure platform for applications.
options.C: Exclusively browsing websites and sending email.
options.D: Editing raster image and video files.

en.explanation: The OS manages hardware abstraction and process execution environments for applications.

uz.context: Kompyuter tizimlarida operatsion tizim (OS) va foydalanuvchi amaliy dasturlari o‘rnatilgan.
uz.question: Operatsion tizimning (OS) asosiy vazifasi nima?

options.A: Insho yozish va elektron jadval tuzishga yordam berish.
options.B: Qurilmalarni boshqarish va boshqa ilovalar ishlashi uchun platforma yaratish.
options.C: Internetda ko‘rish va elektron pochta yuborish.

uz.explanation: OS apparat resurslarini boshqaradi va ilovalar ishlashi uchun zarur tizim interfeyslarini beradi.

en.context: An authentication system requests a master password followed by an OTP code sent to the user's phone (MFA).
en.question: Why is this multi-factor method safer than a password alone?

options.A: It prevents passwords from ever being forgotten.
options.B: It automatically encrypts the local network connection.
options.C: An attacker would need both knowledge of credentials and physical access to the device.
options.D: It accelerates the login handshake latency.

en.explanation: Multi-Factor Authentication requires both a knowledge factor and a possession factor.

uz.context: Autentifikatsiya tizimi avval parolni, keyin esa foydalanuvchining telefoniga yuborilgan kodni (MFA) so‘raydi.
uz.question: Nega bu usul faqat paroldan ko‘ra ancha xavfsizroq?

options.A: Parolni unutib bo‘lmaydigan qiladi.
options.B: Internet ulanishini albatta shifrlaydi.
options.C: Hujumchi ham maxfiy ma’lumotni, ham jismoniy qurilmaga kirishni qo‘lga kiritishi kerak bo‘ladi.

uz.explanation: MFA turli omillarni (bilish va egalik) birlashtiradi, shuning uchun faqat parolni bilish hujumchiga yetarli bo‘lmaydi.

en.context: An engineer is designing a users table in a relational database for 1,000 active accounts.
en.question: Which field is the best Primary Key candidate?

options.A: Student_Full_Name
options.B: Student_Birth_Date
options.C: Student_ID_Number

en.explanation: Names and dates can duplicate; primary keys must guarantee immutable row uniqueness.

uz.context: 1 000 foydalanuvchili tizim uchun foydalanuvchilar ma’lumotlar bazasi (users table) jadvali yaratilmoqda.
uz.question: Qaysi maydon Primary Key (asosiy kalit) uchun eng yaxshi tanlov hisoblanadi?

options.A: Student_Full_Name (To‘liq ism)
options.B: Student_Birth_Date (Tug‘ilgan sana)
options.C: Student_ID_Number (Noyob unikal identifikator)

uz.explanation: Ismlar va sanalar takrorlanishi mumkin. Primary Key har bir qator uchun qat’iy unikal va o‘zgarmas bo‘lishi shart.

en.context: A telemetry sensor records daily temperatures: [15, 12, -99, 14, 16]. You need to calculate the true average temperature.
en.question: How should the data cleaning step handle the -99 outlier?

options.A: Assume all readings are valid and include it directly in the mean.

uz.question: Nega saqlanmagan matn yoki kod yo‘qoladi?

options.A: SSD juda sekin bo‘lgani uchun.
options.B: RAM uchuvchan (volatile) bo‘lib, ma’lumotni saqlab turish uchun uzluksiz elektr quvvati talab qiladi.
options.C: Kompyuter o‘chishdan oldin fayllarni ataylab o‘chiradi.

uz.explanation: RAM ma’lumotni saqlash uchun uzluksiz elektr quvvatiga tayanadi.

en.context: How is high-volume data transmitted across modern TCP/IP networks?
en.question: In what format does data travel across the network?

options.A: As a single unbroken continuous analog stream.
options.B: Segmented into discrete packets that are reassembled at the destination.
options.C: Exclusively through private dedicated point-to-point cables.

en.explanation: Data streams are fragmented into discrete packets for transmission and reassembly.

options.B: Paketlarga bo‘linib alohida yuboriladi va manzilda qayta yig‘iladi.

uz.explanation: Ma’lumotlar kichik paketlarga bo‘linib uzatiladi.

en.context: An email displays the display name "System Administrator", but the actual SMTP sender address is prizes-win-99@gmail.com.
en.question: Should this administrative message be trusted?

options.A: Yes, because the display name says 'Administrator'.
options.B: No; the sender address domain does not match the organization's official domain.
options.C: Yes, because Gmail is a trusted platform.
options.D: No, because administrators never communicate via email.

en.explanation: Display names are trivial to spoof; validating the actual sender domain is critical.

uz.context: Xatdagi ko‘rinadigan ism "Tizim administratori", ammo haqiqiy SMTP jo‘natuvchi manzili prizes-win-99@gmail.com.
uz.question: Bu xatga ishonish kerakmi?

uz.explanation: Ko‘rinadigan ism (display name) osongina soxtalashtiriladi. Asl jo‘natuvchi manzilini tekshirish lozim.

en.context: Consider a personal computer without any installed operating system.
en.question: Why cannot standard user applications execute on bare hardware?

options.A: Applications rely on operating system services to arbitrate hardware and memory.
options.B: They only require higher network bandwidth.
options.C: Applications are themselves complete operating systems.
options.D: Applications can only execute when hosted on cloud servers.

en.explanation: User applications depend on the OS kernel for memory allocation and hardware device drivers.

options.D: Ilovalar faqat bulut serverida saqlansa ishlaydi.

uz.explanation: Ilovalar apparat bilan to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri emas, OS tizim chaqiruvlari (system calls) orqali muloqot qiladi.

en.context: Which option represents a true Multi-Factor Authentication implementation?
en.question: Identify the option that leverages genuinely distinct authentication factor categories.

options.A: A password followed by a second password.
options.B: A password followed by a code sent to your physical device.
options.C: Username and date of birth.

en.explanation: Combining something you know (password) with something you possess (device code) forms true 2FA.

uz.context: Qaysi variant Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) ga eng yaxshi misol?

options.A: Parol, keyin yana boshqa parol.

en.context: In a database schema, Student_ID is designated as the Primary Key.
en.question: What invariant must hold for any two distinct records in this table?

options.A: Their ID values must be identical.
options.B: Their ID values must be distinct (unique).
options.C: They may share duplicate ID values.
options.D: The ID must match their phone number.

en.explanation: Primary keys enforce strict uniqueness across all table records.

uz.context: Ma’lumotlar bazasida Student_ID maydoni Primary Key sifatida belgilangan.

uz.explanation: Primary key hech qachon takrorlanmaydi va har bir yozuvda unikal bo‘ladi.

en.context: A financial column must store decimal currency values like 2500.50 without loss of precision.

en.context: An automated AI system deployed by an enterprise encounters a software failure that causes severe data loss.
en.question: Who is ultimately legally and ethically responsible for the system's deployment and outcomes?

options.A: The AI model itself, as an independent legal person.
options.B: The engineers and organization that developed, tested, and deployed the system.
options.C: Nobody, because software is exempt from liability.
options.D: The landlord of the data center building.

en.explanation: AI models are computational artifacts; accountability strictly rests on the deploying organization and creators.

en.context: A software application needs to compute a simple addition (2 + 2 = 4).

options.A: Yes, neural networks are always superior to traditional arithmetic instructions.

options.C: Yes, because generative AI can produce creative answers beyond 4.
options.D: No, because software models are prohibited from performing math.
